narrative.intro: Mantech TSG 2 Joint Venture recorded $251M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date across 15 awards, with an average award size of $16.7M. Obligations fell 33.8% year over year. Historical obligations by fiscal year were $277M in FY21, $228M in FY22, $249M in FY23, $478M in FY24, $379M in FY25, and $251M in FY26. The FY2026 totals are fiscal year to date and therefore partial. The top reported market for FY2026 to date is Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) at $251M. The dataset notes that contract obligations and award-value figures are different metrics and that some tables report total contract values rather than obligations. Use the fiscal year to date totals with care because they do not represent a full fiscal year.
